goal_versions_to_check.name: goal_versions_to_check
goal_versions_to_check.value: "effective_to" IS NULL OR ("effective_to" IS date("effective_to") AND "effective_to" >= "effective_from")

goal_versions_open_ref_check.name: goal_versions_open_ref_check
goal_versions_open_ref_check.value: "open_ref" IS (CASE WHEN "effective_to" IS NULL THEN "id" END)

goal_versions_start_aligned_check.name: goal_versions_start_aligned_check
goal_versions_start_aligned_check.value:
"period" = 'daily'
        OR ("period" = 'weekly' AND strftime('%w', "effective_from") = '1')
        OR ("period" = 'monthly' AND strftime('%d', "effective_from") = '01')
        OR ("period" = 'yearly' AND strftime('%m-%d', "effective_from") = '01-01')

goal_versions_end_aligned_check.name: goal_versions_end_aligned_check
goal_versions_end_aligned_check.value:
"effective_to" IS NULL OR "period" = 'daily'
        OR ("period" = 'weekly' AND strftime('%w', "effective_to") = '0')
        OR ("period" = 'monthly' AND "effective_to" IS date("effective_to", 'start of month', '+1 month', '-1 day'))
        OR ("period" = 'yearly' AND strftime('%m-%d', "effective_to") = '12-31')

goals_metric_check.name: goals_metric_check
goals_metric_check.value:
("activity" = 'dhikr' AND "metric" IN ('repetitions', 'sessions'))
        OR ("activity" = 'night_prayer' AND "metric" IN ('rakaat', 'nights'))
        OR ("activity" = 'quran' AND "metric" IN ('pages', 'minutes'))
        OR ("activity" = 'fasting' AND "metric" = 'days')
        OR ("activity" = 'sadaqa' AND "metric" IN ('occurrences', 'amount'))

night_prayer_sessions_end_needs_start_ch.name: night_prayer_sessions_end_needs_start_check
night_prayer_sessions_end_needs_start_ch.value: "started_at" IS NOT NULL OR "ended_at" IS NULL

quran_readings_ayah_needs_surah_check.name: quran_readings_ayah_needs_surah_check
quran_readings_ayah_needs_surah_check.value: "start_ayah" IS NULL OR "start_surah" IS NOT NULL

quran_readings_range_order_check.name: quran_readings_range_order_check
quran_readings_range_order_check.value: "end_surah" IS NULL OR "end_surah" > "start_surah" OR ("end_surah" = "start_surah" AND ("start_ayah" IS NULL OR "end_ayah" >= "start_ayah"))
